arxiv-2303-14027.title: Poincaré ResNet
arxiv-2303-14027.creator: Max van Spengler, Erwin Berkhout, Pascal Mettes
arxiv-2303-14027.description: Abstract This paper introduces an end-to-end residual network that operates entirely on the Poincaré ball model of hyperbolic space. Hyperbolic learning has recently shown great potential for visual understanding, but is currently only performed in the penultimate layer(s) of deep networks. All visual representations are still learned through standard Euclidean networks.

arxiv-2408-16429.title: Gradient-free variational learning with conditional mixture networks
arxiv-2408-16429.creator: Conor HeinsVERSES AI Research LabLos Angeles, CA, USAMax Planck Institute of Animal BehaviorDepartment of Collective BehaviourKonstanz, Germany, Hao Wu VERSES AI Research LabLos Angeles, CA, USA, Dimitrije Markovic VERSES AI Research LabLos Angeles, CA, USAChair of Cognitive Computational Neuroscien
arxiv-2408-16429.description: Abstract Balancing computational efficiency with robust predictive performance is crucial in supervised learning, especially for critical applications. Standard deep learning models, while accurate and scalable, often lack probabilistic features like calibrated predictions and uncertainty quantification. Bayesian methods address these issues but can be computationally expensive as model and data complexity increase.

arxiv-2410-20553.title: SPICEPilot: Navigating SPICE Code Generation and Simulation with AI Guidance
arxiv-2410-20553.creator: Deepak Vungarala, Sakila Alam, Arnob Ghosh, Shaahin Angizi
arxiv-2410-20553.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown great potential in automating code generation; however, their ability to generate accurate circuit-level SPICE code remains limited due to a lack of hardware-specific knowledge. In this paper, we analyze and identify the typical limitations of existing LLMs in SPICE code generation.

arxiv-2512-05003.title: Schwarzschild Black Hole Turbulence: Scalar Probe
arxiv-2512-05003.creator: Antonio Riotto
arxiv-2512-05003.description: Abstract We explore how perturbations of a Schwarzschild black hole can redistribute energy among scalar modes and seed turbulent-like cascades. We make use of the van der Pol–Krylov–Bogoliubov averaging method and derive coupled mode equations that describe near-resonant interactions between neighboring multipoles.

pmc-11499069.title: Recurrent fungal endocarditis of the aortic valve: A challenging clinical scenario
pmc-11499069.creator: Shannay Bellamy, Mohammed Mirza, Muhammad Faiq Umar, Jacob Enyia, Khurram Malik, Abdul Ameen, Tyrone Krause
pmc-11499069.description: Key Clinical MessageFungal endocarditis is a rare but potentially fatal infection with significant diagnostic and management challenges. Antifungal therapy and surgical debridement are the preferred treatments in these cases. Antimicrobial therapy with multiple antifungal agents may be required in high‐risk patients presenting with prolonged fever suspected of having fungal endocarditis.

pmc-13641213.title: Influence of Refraction on Widefield Retinal and Choroidal Vascular Metrics in Optical Coherence Tomography Angiography in a Caucasian Population
pmc-13641213.creator: Charlotte Egbring, Sarah Kleemann, Moritz Fabian Danzer, Nicole Eter, Jens Julian Storp
pmc-13641213.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeRefraction-related differences in retinal and choroidal vascular metrics have been reported using optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA), primarily within the central fundus. This study aimed to establish normative vascular reference values for the retina and choroid using widefield swept-source OCTA (WF-SS-OCTA), stratified by spherical equivalent (SE), to characterize associations between refractive status and OCTA-derived vascular measurements extending beyond the central fundus.MethodsIn this prospective single-center study, healthy volunteers underwent WF-SS-OCTA at the University Hospital Münster, Germany.
